preserved_provenance.original_statement: A jar is filled with two non-mixing liquids 1 and 2 having densities $\rho_{1}$ and $\rho_{2}$ respectively. A solid ball, made of a material of density $\rho_{3}$, is dropped in the jar. It comes to equilibrium in the position shown in the figure. Which of the following is true for $\rho_{1}$, $\rho_{1}\text{and }\rho_{3}$?

extraction_metadata.source_misprint: Source text states '\rho_1, \rho_1 and \rho_3' instead of '\rho_1, \rho_2 and \rho_3'; faithfully preserved per Zero Pre-Verification rule.
